scope: Read-only five-page original-asset review; no media edits/new downloads. Six original assets visually inspected (intro, Nirad, AKBir, literature, stamp, book sheet); Parbati conceptual hero dimensions inventoried only.

hero_credit.creator: Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, Government of India

nirad-mohapatra.rationale: Hair already touches original top edge. Top alignment preserves head; remove414px lower torso. Default center crop would remove207px at top and cut scalp. Keep original1728×2574 accessible/retained.
nirad-mohapatra.credit: Raj Sampad / Wikimedia Commons / CC BY-SA4.0; disclose display crop in image credit or linked provenance, preserve licence/source.

ak-bir.rationale: Five visible panellists with four named by source. Do not turn into solo portrait or omit other panellists. Keep event/date and government source/GODL attribution.

the-question-that-brought-me-here.display: Full600×600 square, modest portrait size, no crop.
the-question-that-brought-me-here.rationale: Watercolour-treated user-supplied portrait, not untreated documentary photo or independently CC licensed. Original painterly margins integral; retain.

literature-and-screen.rationale: Left book and right storyboard both support adaptation concept; aggressive portrait crop loses one half. Conceptual illustration, not archival still.

parbati-ghose.stamp: Full344×461, no crop/perforation removal; prefer172–230CSSpx modest object. At344CSSpx only1xresolution. Never call it a film poster or ordinary photograph.
parbati-ghose.sheet: Full918×1188, no crop; preserves opening chapter and margins. Reader can open original for text.
parbati-ghose.credits: Stamp: India Post/Government of India, GODL, Commons link. Book-page rendering: Srujanika/NIT Rourkela digitisation, CommonsCC0 as retained record; caption says PDFpage4. Keep existing qualifiers; no new rights adjudication.

limits: No crop rendered or destructive edit performed. CSS top-aligned recommendation derives from source geometry and direct inspection.
Existing licences/provenance reused; external rights sources were not freshly re-verified.
